brief.en:
Reading board and application specific information (typeplate):
[0,1,2]: Application type number: Axxxxx, 'x' in BCD
[3]: Application version number xx as major.minor, 'x' in BCD
[4,5,6]: Board type number: Bxxxxx, 'x' in BCD
(mandatory service)
brief.de:
Liest board- und applikationsspezifische Informationen (Typenplakette):
[0,1,2]: Applikationstypennummer: Axxxxx, 'x' in BCD
[3]: Applikationsversionsnummer xx as major.minor, 'x' in BCD
[4,5,6]: Boardtypennummer: Bxxxxx, 'x' in BCD
(Pflichtdienst)

brief.en:
Starts (or restarts) the application.
[0]: Trigger value 94 ( = 0x5E, '^')
(mandatory service)

Starts (or restarts) the program loader module.
[0]: Trigger value 94 ( = 0x5E, '^')
(mandatory service)

Setting the Cy4NET address:
[0]: Net address: 1 .. 255
[1]: Device address: 1 .. 254
(mandatory service)
